Name: Kenneth's Weapon Shop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Weapon Shop[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Adds a new constructible building - Kenneth's Weapon Shop (built by Robin) - with 25 new weapons like swords, daggers and claymores to Stardew Valley[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Swords like Black Machete Blade, Dark Guard Iron Sword, Gold Guard Steel Sword, Red Cross Guard Sword, Gold Guard Long Sword, Broad Silver Sword, Iron Short Sword, Red Guard Long Sword, Silver Hook Sword, Steel Long Sword Brown Guard, Wood Hilt Short Sword, Light Blue Long Sword, Dark Steel Long Sword, Gold Cross Guard Sword, Metal Silver Sword, Silver Cross Guard Sword, Orange Cross Guard Sword, Wooden Training Sword, Stone Black Claymore, Ornate Green Guard Sword[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Daggers and knives like Golden Dagger, Brown Handle Kitchen Knife, Black Short Dagger, Small Brown Tip Knife, Small Red Edge Knife[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- All weapons have balanced damage, speed, knockback, crit chance and defense stats[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All weapons are sold in Kenneth's Weapon Shop building. The building has 5 shop variants with portraits[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Building Details[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Size: 10x3 tiles[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Build cost: 3000g[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Build time: 3 days[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Perfection Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod does not block perfection.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Building Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Recommended to build on bigger maps like Kenneth's Spacious Farm, Kenneth's Vast Farm, Kenneth's Massive Farm or other custom farm maps for more space. Can still be built on the vanilla farm map as long as you have enough space on your land[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]
